notes: Nintendo JP «ファミコンとは？» hardware page (text based on the original instruction booklet, per the page). The console 「十字ボタンとA、Bボタンを配置したコントローラーを2つ搭載」 (carries two controllers with a cross button and A, B buttons) — the source for dpad 1 + face_button 2 on each, for wired=true and ports [cable 1] (the controllers are built into the console, cords permanently attached; the cord length is not printed), and for host_console. Dimensions and mass: not published; the page's 約620g is the console INCLUDING both controllers (「I ・Ⅱコントローラーを含む」), so no controller mass can be read from it. No battery. released (1983-07-15 per secondary sources) is not on the page: null. Controller II (2人プレイ用): the page adds a microphone (MIC.) and a VOLUME control instead of SELECT/START → controls dpad 1 + face_button 2, and features.microphone=true (a presence flag; the family plan's P2 microphone). The VOLUME control has no contract kind and is not in controls; this makes the controls list complete for contract kinds only — a reader must not treat VOLUME as absent (see this note).
